title: P112: preserve marked recovery through query-only matroid relaxations
body:
The full matroid of a rational decoder can fail in characteristic two while its required target recoveries still transfer. This package proves a screening lemma: relaxing a query-only circuit-hyperplane preserves every marked recovery and every query coordinate-zero pattern, conditional on a characteristic-two representation of the relaxation. It also records the conditional stressed-hyperplane extension using Ferroni, Nasr and Vecchi's exact rank-change theorem.

An explicit three-hub signed-graph/Dowling dictionary supplies an F4 witness. Only one of512 augmented subset ranks changes: its query-only triangle becomes independent. All192 target/support requests transfer. Arbitrary rational actual readers and arbitrary placements of three disjoint canonical marks consequently retain at least their original bill:18 for three ordinary marks, and334 with the untouched canonical completion. This rules out this dictionary and its rescalings/duplicates; it does not claim that every relaxation is representable or that arbitrary new queries are excluded. No improved decoder, native schedule, selected exponent or universal dense-factor floor is claimed.

Validation at `ce9001dcb5a2c74002e1f9b57fcdb0df822900fd`: both registered standard-library replays, metadata and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. The independent checker uses integer determinants and explicit F4 span sets, with no producer imports. The primary checker authenticates the two foundational inputs, all111556 entries of the full-group I334 expansion, every canonical term invoice and a local I18 restriction. The official Git-free export passes both commands with empty PATH and read-only files; all11 file hashes stay unchanged (0.42seconds, Python3.12.14 on Windows). Reproduce with `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-selective-circuit-relaxation`. The general lemma remains a written proof; the finite checks certify the fixed witness and geometry.

Canonical main was refreshed before publication and remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7. The assigned P112 decoder goal is recorded as a scope change. A fresh update-ordered open-PR delta supplements the earlier complete snapshot; Discussion coverage remains unavailable after HTTP406, so no exhaustive novelty claim is made. No pending PR is a scientific dependency.

Zaslavsky's *Signed Graphs and Geometry*, Section5.6, supplies the configuration; the marked choice, F4 witness, selective-transfer deductions and P112 application are local. Ferroni, Nasr and Vecchi, arXiv:2110.08869v2, Theorem3.4/Proposition3.7, supply the stressed-hyperplane rank-change rule. Source links and precise attribution are in the package. Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI-agent audits. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
